title: Malaysian and Filipino drug suspects killed and 2 women hit by stray bullets in a buy-bust shootout in Tubig Mampallam, Bongao
summary: A Malaysian national, Janimal Bin Hajad, alias "Ungod", and a Filipino, Sansibar Amirul Amil, were killed when they opened fire on agents of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency, backed by police and Philippine Marines, during a buy-bust operation at about 4:50 p.m. on 15 November 2026 in Barangay Tubig Mampallam, Bongao, Tawi-Tawi, according to PDEA Tawi-Tawi provincial officer Abraham Solon Kalim. The 2 tried to escape on a motorized wooden boat while firing. 2 women, not named, were wounded by stray bullets and taken to hospital; no government personnel were hurt. About 2 kilograms of suspected shabu, worth P13.4 million, a pistol and the boat were seized. PNA's photo caption dates the operation to Saturday, 14 November, and a Manila Bulletin headline speaks of 2 cohorts killed; PNA's and The Chronicle's reports give 15 November and 2 dead.
